text: In the ESN used for Lorenz prediction, only the readout matrix W_out is learned (via ridge regression); the recurrent weights W_rec and input weights W_in remain fixed random matrices.
explanation: This is the defining feature of reservoir computing and of the lab's EchoStateNetwork: W_rec and W_in are constructed once (random, with W_rec rescaled to the target spectral radius) and never trained. Only W_out is fit, by ridge regression on the collected reservoir states after washout.
